name: gmp-wasm
description: Vendored copy of gmp-wasm 1.1.0 (upstream Daninet/gmp-wasm). Consumed through the `gmp-wasm` path alias, not as an npm dependency, so the RSA-decrypt path of the vendored @l2js/core cannot be affected by an upstream unpublish/hijack. Only the prebuilt ESM bundle (WASM embedded as base64) and its .d.ts types are kept. To update: `npm i -D gmp-wasm@<ver>` in a scratch dir, copy dist/index.esm.min.js + dist/types + LICENSE here, bump this version.
author: Dani Biro <danibiro93@gmail.com> (https://danibiro.com)
